description: China's non-financial outward direct investment (对外直接投资, ODI) — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE amount in USD 100M, number of enterprises investing abroad, and the count of countries/regions reached, each with year-over-year %. Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January (累计 = Jan-through-month, not a standalone monthly flow) — the response's `note` field restates this. No per-country breakdown is available (the country count is a COUNT, not a split by destination). Answers "China's outward FDI this year", "how many Chinese enterprises are investing abroad", "China ODI growth rate".

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

name: mofcom_odi
